verdict.rationale: Sill's privacy page says there is no account and no server, and that screen content and typed input travel only between the user's own devices. By design, user data never reaches the vendor and so could not be collected for model training. However, the docs never explicitly address AI training, so this protection is implied by the architecture rather than stated. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that data is not used for AI/model training, and independent verification of the no-server data flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
